strings.evidence.heading: Ekyo ky'olaba ku satalayiti mu nnimiro
strings.evidence.veg.heading: Obulungi obwa kiragala omwaka gwonna (NDVI)
strings.evidence.veg.what: NDVI kye kibalo ekiraga obulungi bw’ettaka okuva mu bbanga. Okumpi ne 0.1 kitegeeza ettaka eritalina bimera. 0.6 oba okusingawo kitegeeza ebimera eby’amaanyi. Kiraga ddi ettaka eriri okumpi n’ennimiro lwe lyekutte ku bimera era ddi lwe liriko obutaliimu.
strings.evidence.veg.season: Ekiseera {season} ({months}): okutwaliza awamu NDVI {mean}, mu mwaka ogw'ekyeya {p20}, mu mwaka gw'enkuba {p80}.
strings.evidence.veg.check_ok: Emyezi egisinga obulungi giba mu biseera byaffe eby’okulima era ettaka liba nga teri bulungi nnyo mu January okutuuka mu March, ng’obutandika okulima tekunnaba. Naye ekikula kya bulungi kisigala nga kyekutte wakati w’ebiseera ebibiri, olwo obulungi bwokka tebusobola kubawula.
strings.evidence.veg.check_off: Ebbanga erya kiragala erisinga terikwatagana na biseera byaffe. Kebera ebiseera n'omulimi ow'omu kitundu oba kalenda y'ebirime.
strings.evidence.veg.limit: Buli square mu kifaananyi kya satellite kiba nga 6 ha. Ekibanja kino kya 2 ha. Noolwekyo ekifaananyi kikwata n’ettaka eriri okumpi n’ekibanja. Emiti oba ebikajjo ebiri ku ttale bisobola okukweka ebitundu ebitalina muntu. Ebire bisigala nga byawula. Omulimi yekka amanyi ekirimu mu ttale.
strings.evidence.veg.source: Ensibuko: NASA MODIS, 250 m, buli luvannyuma lwa nnaku 16, okuva ku {start} okutuuka ku {end}.
strings.evidence.terrain.heading: Obulimba bw'ettaka
strings.evidence.terrain.frost_none: Tewali kabi konna wano: ekiro ekisinze okuba eky'obunnyogovu mu myaka 25 kyasigala ku ddiguli 14 °C.
strings.evidence.terrain.limit: Ekitundu ky’obugulumivu kikolebwa mu squares za mita 30. Ekibanja kino ekya 2 ha kizingiramu obutono bw’ebikadde byokka. Kiraga engeri ettaka gy’eri, si bifo bitono ebisukka oba ebikadde mu nnimiro yo.
strings.evidence.footprint: Tuteebereza nti faamu ya mita 140 ku buli ludda ng'esinzira ku kifo ky'ennimiro.
strings.evidence.pos.high: Ekifo ekigulumivu: amazzi g'enkuba gakulukuta okuva ku faamu
strings.evidence.pos.low: Ettaka eriri wansi: amazzi g'enkuba okuva mu bitundu ebya waggulu gayinza okukuŋŋaanira wano
strings.evidence.pos.mid: Mu makkati g'olusozi: nga si lwa waggulu oba wansi
strings.evidence.rain.heading: Okuteebereza kw'enkuba okusatu kugeraageranyiziddwa
strings.evidence.rain.note: Enkola ssatu ez'enjawulo ez'okupima enkuba ku faamu. NASA POWER ne ERA5 bya kompyuta ebikwata ku mbeera y'obudde, era bikwatagana nnyo. GPM IMERG ekozesebwa okuva mu satelayiti era eraga enkuba ennyingi. Tetumanyi ki ekirungi ku faamu eno. Omugereko gw'enkuba (ekikopo ekikwata enkuba) gusobola okulaga kino. Noolwekyo app eraga zonna essatu.
strings.evidence.rain.et0_note: ET0 kye ky’ensulo y’amazzi enjuba n’omuyaga gye zisobola okukaza mu kiseera kimu okuva ku muddo ogw’obulamu ogulina amazzi gonna ge gwetaaga. Ekirime kikozesa ekitundu ku ET0 kino. Singa ET0 esukka ku nkuba, ebirime bisigala ku mazzi agali mu ttaka.
strings.evidence.rain.source: Ensibuko: NASA POWER, NASA GPM IMERG, ERA5 (ECMWF, okuyita mu Open-Meteo; ET0 nga bwe yabalirwa Open-Meteo).
strings.evidence.field.heading: Ku kisaawe ky'ennimiro kyennyini (mita 30)
strings.evidence.field.what: Landsat asobola okulaba ebintu eby’omutindo ogwa 30 m, n’olwekyo asobola okukuba ekifaananyi kya square ya 140 m nga kyenkana ku faamu eno. Obusimba obulungi bulaga obugumu bw’ekifo ekyo, ate obusimba obweru bulaga ekifo ekikulu ekirabibwa ne MODIS, okwegeraageranya.
strings.evidence.field.bare_heading: Ekibangirizi ky'ennimiro kifaanana nga kikalu emirundi emeka buli mwezi?
strings.evidence.field.bare_what: Ekibalo ky'ebifaananyi bya satalayiti ebyeyoleka obulungi nga ettaka lirabika nga lya bwereere (NDVI wansi wa 0.25).
strings.evidence.field.least: Ebbanga erisinga okubaamu ebimera ebitono mu nnimiro: {months}.
strings.evidence.field.thin: Ebifaananyi ebitono (ebitakka wansi wa 8) mu: {months}. Kozesa emyezi egyo n'obwegendereza.
strings.evidence.field.season: Ekiseera {season}: NDVI eya bulijjo {mean}; nga tewali mu {bare} % ku bifaananyi ebirungi.
strings.evidence.field.source: Ensibuko: NASA/USGS Landsat 8 ne 9, 30 m, ebifaananyi ebyeru {clear}, {start} okutuuka ku {end}.
strings.evidence.field.limit: Ekifo kya mita 140 square kye tukakasa, si nsalo eyapimiddwa. Ebire bisazaamu ebifaananyi bingi mu mwezi ogw’enkuba. NDVI teyinza kulaga ekirime ki ekikula oba lwaki ettaka liri bwereere.
